rows.en: I'm sure everyone being treated feels the same way!
Now then, even as we speak, the enemy must be steadily building up its forces.
The heroes returned to the base.
Their Celestial Being comrades went into the medical room to recover.
Seravee's voice, now one with Veda, reached the base as well.
In the strategy meeting already under way, Seravee played a central role, just as before.
About the location of the Cube where Belial lies in wait... Seravee, does Veda have any information?
I have nothing certain, but from the concentration of Minus Energy and such...
I can predict its position coordinates.
Excellent! Will you do it for us?
Yes, if you'll give me a little time.
Good. I'm counting on you.
Belial... He's an enemy I can't let live for even one more second.
Hold yourself back, Zero. You won't win a fight driven by anger.
This Dinosaur Greeed concerns me too. From what they said, he seems to be one of the masterminds.
He's said to be the strongest Greeed of all.
Even stronger than Shocker Greeed?
Yes... Probably...
What concerns me is the Devil Gundam. The one we beat in the Veda Cube was in its earliest form.
If it escaped, it may be evolving somewhere...!!
...I've identified the Cube's coordinates.
Oh! Well done!!
I'll transfer the data to your MAP.
As for our route in... As expected, it seems the only way is through the Ride Gate Belial fled by.
A frontal assault, huh... They must have a sizable force posted there.
Also, there's one thing that concerns me...
What is it?
Part of Veda has been rewritten by someone, and there's a region I can't access.
What!?
It can't be...!? Is there another Innovator besides Reborns!?
It's a guess, but someone besides an Innovator may have gained access rights somehow.
How could that be...!?
This isn't our original world. Anything could happen here.
What about the Colony Laser?
About that... Part of the Colony Laser's control is handled by the region I can't access.
But since it's only part of it, neither side can use the Colony Laser at the moment.
I see. But there's a good chance they'll expand that region.
Then we just have to beat the enemy before that happens, right?
Yeah, we've got no time to sit around like this. Let's wrap this up fast.
It seems we don't have time to wait for Celestial Being's Gundams to recover...
Captain Zoffy! Please leave this to us.
Just leave it to us! My climax is gonna keep goin' right to the very, very end!!
Very well... Everyone! I hereby order you to sortie!
Targets: Belial, Dinosaur Greeed, and the Devil Gundam!
Roger!
Roger!
Roger!
Everyone...! I think it's about time for me to...
Methuss!!
Zeta, I'll go back first and wait for you.
Yeah.
Methuss...!! ...Let's meet again somewhere!!
You bet!! Take care of yourself!!
Me too... Riders, Gundams... I hate to leave, but this is goodbye.
Hikari, we were only able to fight thanks to you. I'm grateful.
And it's thanks to Hikari that the Ride Machine got finished, too.
It was a fascinating experience for me as well... Whoops, looks like I've hit my limit...
Farewell.
Huh...!? Me too... What? It came out of nowhere!!
Hahaha!! See ya, Birth!! Hope you make your hundred million soon!!
Yeah!! Too bad I can't pay you guys back... See ya!!
One after another, their comrades were pulled back to their original worlds.
It seems my turn has come.
Zoffy, you guarded the base well, right to the very end.
Meeting heroes I never knew, I feel I've learned something as well.
I won't forget this for as long as I live... Well then...!!
Hm!? Now it's my turn...!!
God Gundam...! Take care.
Yeah, you guys too.
Well... once I'm back, I'll have to retrain for the next Gundam Fight.
Next time we meet somewhere, you're teaching me how to do the God Finger.
All right. I promise.
Yeah.
See ya!!
...!! ...Looks like I'm next!!
RX! Don't forget about us Ultra Brothers either!!
Of course I won't!!
All of you are out there fighting for justice in some world... Just thinking that fills me with strength.
Well, this is it!! Thank you!!
RX! Don't you forget about us!

notes.note: MainEventMess0929 has no event script (not in script_table_refs); it is an unused draft of the post-Veda Cube scene that 0930 replaces. 0.34 is feminine speech, most likely Methuss; 0.35 speaker unknown, wording kept neutral.
Subject of 'held the central role' is Seravee's voice; written as 'Seravee' (glossary g=m).
0930.bla checked: TextIdOffset+N plays entry N+1 throughout (+4 Zoffy = 0.5 about Belial/Veda; +36 W = 0.37; +44 Nu = 0.45). Extracted labels for 0.5-0.45 are correct.
Row 0.7 completes 0.6 ('...from the Minus Energy concentration, I can predict...'); subject 'I' restored (Seravee speaking for Veda).
Seven to Zero (father to son): firm, not harsh.
'Kuromaku no hitori' = 'one of the masterminds'. Dinosaur Greeed gender per glossary (m).
Seravee drops polite speech here because he is answering 00 (a Celestial Being comrade), as Tieria would.
Subject of 'expand the region' unstated; read as whoever holds the rewritten region ('they'), which Zero's reply ('beat the enemy before that happens') supports.
Zoffy-taichou -> 'Captain Zoffy' (Space Garrison captain); not an honorific to drop.
Momotaros 'climax' catchphrase variant ('till the very end').

0.46-0.98 (and beyond, to 0.249) are NOT played by 0930.bla (it only reaches TextIdOffset+44 = 0.45) and appear nowhere else: an unused farewell/ending sequence. No speakers recoverable; inferred from content. 0.50/0.52 Methuss, 0.53 Zeta Gundam, 0.54 probably Mebius ('Methuss-san'), 0.55 unknown hero.
0.58-0.62: Hikari leaving (0.59 and 0.60 are others thanking him; 0.59 uses 'boku', possibly Nu Gundam or Mebius). 'Ride Machine' per glossary.
0.64-0.66: Birth (Date) leaving; 0.65 a teasing hero (rough voice, maybe Momotaros). 'Ichioku' = his 100-million-yen goal; 'hundred million' matches the earlier Birth line.
0.75-0.78: read as Zoffy leaving; 0.76 another hero praising him for guarding the base. If 0.75 is someone else, the English still works.
0.83-0.90: God Gundam leaving. 0.87 speaker unknown; 'God Finger' (glossary has 'Erupting God Finger' for the full attack; the short form is used as a casual reference).
0.93-0.98: Black RX leaving. 0.94 an Ultra (Ultra Brothers), 0.98 a Gundam (RX answers 'the Gundams helped me a lot' in 0.99, next slice).

report: 80/80 rows. 0930 #0.1-0.45 script-verified (TextIdOffset+N -> entry N+1), extracted labels correct. 0929 #0.34-35 has no script (unused draft); 0930 #0.50-0.98 is an unplayed farewell sequence with no script, speakers inferred from content. No identical earlier Japanese except short stock lines (What is it?, Roger!, Methuss!!, Yeah., See ya!!), reused. Not in glossary: Innovator, Colony Laser, medical room (all follow earlier slices).
